descriptor: An AI-powered operational intelligence platform for NHS to predict pressure, identify risks, and recommend interventions.

requirements.statement: The system must ingest data from GP practice management software.
The system must ingest data from NHS central data systems.
The system must ingest data from the Ambulance service database.
The system must ingest data from the Community care management system.
The system must ingest data from Staffing rotas.
The system must ingest data from Emergency department records.
The system must ingest data from the 111 database.
The system must ingest data from Discharge records.
The system must ingest data from the Hospital bed occupancy record.
The system must predict operational pressure within the next 4-24 hours.
The system must provide recommendations for interventions to manage demand and capacity.
The system must provide a concise briefing for the operational leadership team.
The system must flag data uncertainties for human review.
The system must reduce operational decision-making time from 3 hours to under 1 hour.
The system must provide an AI What-If Simulator for scenario planning.
The system must display current and forecasted operational metrics on a dashboard.
The system must use Claude Code for AI development.
The system must not make autonomous clinical decisions.

releases.demo: Demonstrate predictions and risk assessments by specialized agents.
releases.goal: Develop specialized AI agents for prediction and risk assessment.
releases.name: AI Intelligence Layer

releases.demo: Show decision recommendations and dashboard displaying operational metrics.
releases.goal: Implement decision engine and executive dashboard.
releases.name: AI Decision Engine and Dashboard

releases.demo: Demonstrate scenario planning and data uncertainty flagging.
releases.goal: Introduce scenario planning and governance features.
releases.name: AI What-If Simulator and Governance

releases.demo: Show reduced decision-making time and full system integration.
releases.goal: Optimize performance and integrate all components.
releases.name: Performance Optimization and Final Integration

stories.title: Enable data-driven insights from GP practice management software
stories.narrative: As a healthcare analyst, I want to ingest and analyze data from GP practice management software, so that I can derive actionable insights.
acceptance: Given data from GP practice management software, when ingested, then insights are generated successfully.
Given data ingestion fails, when retrying, then the system logs the failure and retries.
Trust: All data ingestion attempts are logged with timestamps and outcomes.
stories.task_guidance: Connect to the GP practice management software API, ingest data into the analytics platform, and ensure logging of all data transactions.

stories.title: Enable data-driven insights from NHS central data systems
stories.narrative: As a healthcare analyst, I want to ingest and analyze data from NHS central data systems, so that I can derive actionable insights.
acceptance: Given data from NHS central data systems, when ingested, then insights are generated successfully.
Given data ingestion fails, when retrying, then the system logs the failure and retries.
Trust: All data ingestion attempts are logged with timestamps and outcomes.
stories.task_guidance: Connect to the NHS central data systems API, ingest data into the analytics platform, and ensure logging of all data transactions.

stories.title: Implement AI Decision Engine
stories.narrative: As a data analyst, I want an AI decision engine, so that I can automate decision-making processes.
acceptance: Given the AI decision engine is operational, when a decision-making process is initiated, then the engine should provide a decision output within 5 seconds.
Given the AI decision engine is operational, when an invalid input is provided, then the engine should return an error message.
Trust: Given the AI decision engine is operational, when a decision is made, then the decision should be logged with a timestamp and decision parameters.
stories.task_guidance: Implement the decision engine using the specified AI framework. Ensure integration with the data sources and logging mechanisms.

stories.title: Develop Executive Command Dashboard
stories.narrative: As a UI/UX designer, I want to develop an Executive Command Dashboard, so that NHS executives can view operational metrics.
acceptance: Given operational data, when processed, then the dashboard displays current and forecasted metrics.
Given incomplete data, when processed, then the dashboard flags it for review.
Trust: The dashboard logs all display activities and flags data issues.
stories.task_guidance: Design and implement a dashboard using Claude Code to display operational metrics and forecasts for NHS executives.

stories.title: Implement AI What-If Simulator
stories.narrative: As an AI architect, I want to implement an AI What-If Simulator, so that NHS executives can perform scenario planning.
acceptance: Given a scenario input, when processed, then the simulator forecasts the impact accurately.
Given conflicting scenario inputs, when processed, then the simulator flags them for review.
Trust: The simulator logs all scenario activities and flags conflicts.
stories.task_guidance: Develop the What-If Simulator using Claude Code to model potential impacts of different scenarios on operational metrics.

stories.title: Implement Data Uncertainty Flagging
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want to implement data uncertainty flagging, so that uncertain data is reviewed by humans.
acceptance: Given uncertain data, when detected, then the system flags it for human review.
Given certain data, when processed, then the system does not flag it.
Trust: The system logs all flagging activities and ensures human review.
stories.task_guidance: Develop a mechanism using Claude Code to detect and flag uncertain data for human review.

stories.title: Optimize Performance for Decision-Making
stories.narrative: As a performance engineer, I want to optimize the system's performance, so that decision-making time is reduced to under 1 hour.
acceptance: Given operational data, when processed, then the system completes decision-making in under 1 hour.
Given high data volume, when processed, then the system maintains performance.
Trust: The system logs performance metrics and ensures compliance with time constraints.
stories.task_guidance: Optimize data processing and decision-making algorithms using Claude Code to meet performance requirements.

stories.title: Establish trust spine for data ingestion and prediction
stories.narrative: As a system auditor, I want to ensure all data ingestion and prediction processes are logged and idempotent, so that the system's operations can be audited and verified.
acceptance: Given a data ingestion process, when completed, then it is logged with a unique transaction ID.
Given a prediction process, when completed, then it is logged with a unique transaction ID.
Trust: All processes are idempotent and logs are immutable.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logging for all data ingestion and prediction processes, ensuring each process is idempotent and logs are stored in an immutable format.

stories.title: Develop AI Intelligence Layer
stories.narrative: As a data scientist, I want an AI intelligence layer, so that I can enhance data insights with AI capabilities.
acceptance: Given the AI intelligence layer is developed, when data is processed, then enhanced insights should be generated.
Given the AI intelligence layer is developed, when no data is available, then the system should notify the user of missing data.
Trust: Given the AI intelligence layer is developed, when insights are generated, then the process should be logged with a timestamp and data source.
stories.task_guidance: Develop the intelligence layer using the specified AI tools. Ensure it integrates with existing data systems and logs all processes.
